notes: 160 bars of 4/4 at 125 BPM is 307.2 s (14,745,600 samples at 48 kHz). The container is 307.224 s because of MP3 priming (1105 samples, start time 0.023021 s) and one trailing frame. Chrome decodeAudioData and ffmpeg drop that priming and land on exactly 14,745,600 samples, so loopStart is 0 and loopEnd is 307.2 s. The wrap step is about 0.001, under a normal sample step, so no seam ramp is applied. No loudness trim: the true peak is -1.3 dBTP. Decoded stereo float PCM is 117,964,800 bytes. Only the selected stage's long bed stays decoded. A failed decode still falls back to the synthesised fight loop. Replaces bar_rock_loop.mp3. Hatchery does not use this file.
